meta.title: Convert.io — find what your landing page is losing
meta.description: We audit your landing page, generate variants, and let a bandit decide which one earns the most revenue per visitor.

hero.headline: Find out what your landing page is costing you
hero.lede: We audit the page, propose variants, and measure them against revenue per visitor rather than clicks.

steps.title: Audit
steps.body: Deterministic checks first, judgment second. Every finding cites the evidence it came from.

steps.title: Propose
steps.body: Each finding becomes a variant you approve before a single visitor sees it.

steps.title: Measure
steps.body: A bandit sends traffic toward what earns, and keeps measuring the rest.

sections.heading: Clicks are not the thing you sell
body: A headline that lifts clicks and drops orders is a loss the usual dashboard reports as a win.
Every arm here is scored on revenue per visitor. A visitor who never ordered counts as a zero, which is what moves a high-click, low-order page down.

sections.heading: Audit your page
sections.sub: One URL. The report comes back with findings ranked by impact per effort.
